fit_card: Scored this butterfly print baby tee on Depop for just $18 and I’m literally obsessed. Perfect for leaning into that nostalgic Y2K streetwear vibe with baggy denim and chunky sneakers. Can't wait to style it with wide-leg trousers for a chill vintage look, too!

Scored this vintage light wash cropped denim jacket on Poshmark for just $42, and I am obsessed. The wash contrast looks so good layered over a basic white tank and dark baggy jeans for that ultimate casual streetwear vibe. Can't wait to style it with an oversized crewneck and combat boots next!

Scored these white chunky sole platform sneakers on Poshmark for just $48 and I am so obsessed! They give the absolute best Y2K streetwear vibe when I pair them with baggy dark wash denim, a ribbed tank, and a cropped zip hoodie. Can't wait to style them with wide-leg trousers and an oversized crewneck for that effortless off-duty look, too.

Scored this Y2K butterfly baby tee on Depop for just $18 and I am obsessed. Definitely leaning into the nostalgic streetwear vibe today with baggy dark-wash denim, a vintage black jacket, and chunky white sneakers. Such a cute little graphic piece to add to the rotation!

Just scored these khaki low-rise cargo pants on Poshmark for only $27 and I am officially living my 2000s pop star dreams. I paired them with a black cropped zip hoodie, chunky combat boots, and a crossbody bag for the ultimate Y2K streetwear moment. Honestly obsessed with how effortless this fit turned out!

Scored this 2003 bootleg tour graphic tee on Depop for just $24 and I'm honestly obsessed. It’s giving the absolute best grungy, 90s streetwear energy whether I pair it with baggy dark denim and combat boots or style it down with wide-leg trousers. Such a good vintage find that’s definitely staying in constant rotation!

Scored this mesh long-sleeve top on Depop for just $15 and I am so obsessed with it. It’s giving the ultimate grunge Y2K energy layered over a ribbed tank with my chunky boots. Can’t wait to style it under an oversized crewneck and khaki trousers for that perfect edgy casual vibe, too!

Scored these vintage Levi's 501 jeans on Depop for just $38 and I am never taking them off. They are the absolute holy grail for casual streetwear days with a simple white tank and chunky sneakers, or dressed down with an oversized grey crewneck and combat boots. Real vintage denim just hits different, and this wash is literally perfection.

Scored this chunky brown knit cardigan on Depop for just $35 and I'm never taking it off. It’s giving the ultimate cozy, earth-toned cottagecore vibe whether I'm styling it oversized with khaki trousers or adding some edge with baggy denim and combat boots. My new favorite thrifted emotional support sweater is officially secured.

Scored this oversized red and black flannel on thredUp for just $22 and I'm already obsessed. It's the ultimate 90s grunge layering piece over a white tank and combat boots, but it also looks so good peeking out under a black denim jacket. My new fall uniform is officially sorted.
